story.huntcraft.arrival.text:
Kazami Village is a small settlement in a mountain valley.
Long ago, a hunter and a mofu learned to read the winds that sweep through the valley. By knowing where the monsters roamed, they protected the people here - or so the old tales say.

Today the guild keeps an office in the gathering hall, and the smithy, the general store, the Mofu Diner and the Mofu Lodge all support the hunters.

From today you are one of us. Come to me whenever you need anything.
story.huntcraft.arrival.title: A Village of Winds
story.huntcraft.dark_flame.text:
You defeated Azragos...! At last the wind in the valley is calm again.
Your name will be carved on the village wind-pillar, just like the first hunter and mofu.

But the hunt never truly ends. The wind will bring new tidings. Please keep watching over Kazami Village.
story.huntcraft.dark_flame.title: Beyond the Dark Flame
story.huntcraft.ember.text:
...Let me tell you an old story.
Ages ago, a dragon wreathed in dark flame tried to burn this valley to ashes. The hunter and the mofu who founded the village read the winds, foresaw the dragon's path, and drove it off at the risk of their lives.

Of late, black smoke rises from deep within the Ember Caldera. I pray that dragon has not returned...
story.huntcraft.ember.title: Legend of the Burning Valley
story.huntcraft.first_hunt.text:
I hear you brought down a large monster. Splendid!
But never forget: we live by taking lives. Waste none of what you carve - let Gentetsu forge it into fine gear.

To hunt is to face a living creature. Without fear, without contempt, with respect. That is the way of Kazami's hunters.
story.huntcraft.first_hunt.title: The First Hunt
story.huntcraft.high_rank.text:
The guild has recognized you as a high rank hunter. Congratulations!
In high rank hunting grounds the monsters are fiercer by far. But you already know how to read the wind.

The whole village relies on you now. Please, always come home safe.
story.huntcraft.high_rank.title: Pride of a High Rank Hunter

story.huntcraft.rumors.text:
Lately the travelling merchants bring strange rumours.
In the Frostpeak mountains a white-fanged beast calls the blizzards, and in the skies a great serpent clad in lightning strikes the earth. In the southern crater, they say, a rock-like wyvern shakes the very ground.

Perhaps that is why the wind is so restless. Hone your skills, and never neglect your preparations.
story.huntcraft.rumors.title: Rumours from North and South
